lead_raw_text:
The structure of Na8Mg4Si4 (reduced formula Na2MgSi) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I4/mmm (No. 15), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows all four elements in tetrahedral coordination: Mg and Si each have four Na neighbors, while Na has four Mg and four Si neighbors, with neighbor distances near 2.74–2.75 Å. The periodic neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis identifies corner- and edge-sharing between Na and Si tetrahedra, and edge-sharing between Mg and Si tetrahedra.
